scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.

coordinates.role: operand slot (a/b/c) x static opcode category of the hit instruction; k=2 adjacent instructions at 4 anchors; DYNAMIC REACH DROPPED (no per-instruction trace in the frozen VM) - translation loss
coordinates.pairwise: k=4 as two 2-windows at anchor pairs (6) vs each window alone; epistasis = loss_ij - [1-(1-loss_i)(1-loss_j)]
coordinates.held_out: delete k=4 at 1 / 4 sites scored on W0_heldout, W1_d1, W1_d4, W2_K2d1 (reward delta, exaptation)

programs: viable parents, walker-16, C4-08 tops (n >= 8 instructions)
material_rule: role: any slot or category marginal differs from the grand mean with a disjoint Wilson band; pairwise: mean epistasis outside its sign-flip band; held-out: exaptation rate on any family >= .05 with Wilson lower bound > 0
